title: DataLabs · RAG LC 214
description: LC 214/2025 RAG: data contract, retrieval gate (lc05), answer gate (lc06), drift and cost. Every series comes from audit.pipeline_step_runs; each gate records its own floor.

options.content: **How to read.** Solid line = the run's metric; dashed = the gate floor (baseline − a tolerance of 1 case). Gate standing = the solid line does not cross the dashed one. *Margin* = the smallest distance to the floor. The model's wording changes between runs; its verdict does not (text drift is recorded, not a failure).

panels.title: Retrieval gate (lc05)
panels.description: Latest evaluate_retrieval result: passing = within the floor; failed = regression or step error; interrupted = process killed from outside (SIGTERM), unrelated to quality.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN status = 'success' THEN 1 WHEN exit_code IN (137, 143) THEN 2 ELSE 0 END FROM (SELECT metrics AS m, status, exit_code FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'evaluate_retrieval' AND status IN ('success','failed') ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1) l

panels.title: Answer gate (lc06)
panels.description: Latest generate_answers result (dev subset, ADR 0015). Interrupted = process killed from outside (SIGTERM): run it again, quality was not measured.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN status = 'success' THEN 1 WHEN exit_code IN (137, 143) THEN 2 ELSE 0 END FROM (SELECT metrics AS m, status, exit_code FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'generate_answers' AND status IN ('success','failed') ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1) l

panels.title: Minimum margin · retrieval
panels.description: Smallest (metric − floor) across success@k, MRR and context_recall. Negative = regression. A metric exactly on its baseline has a margin of 1 case (the tolerance): that is rest, not an alert. Empty until the first run that records the floors.

targets.rawSql: SELECT LEAST((m->>'fiscal_success_at_k')::float - (m->>'floor_fiscal_success_at_k')::float, (m->>'fiscal_mrr')::float - (m->>'floor_fiscal_mrr')::float, (m->>'fiscal_context_recall')::float - (m->>'floor_fiscal_context_recall')::float, (m->>'formal_success_at_k')::float - (m->>'floor_formal_success_at_k')::float, (m->>'formal_mrr')::float - (m->>'floor_formal_mrr')::float, (m->>'formal_context_recall')::float - (m->>'floor_formal_context_recall')::float) FROM (SELECT metrics AS m, status, exit_code FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'evaluate_retrieval' AND status IN ('success','failed') ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1) l

panels.title: Minimum margin · answers
panels.description: Smallest (metric − floor) across refusal accuracy and citation recall, per group. On the baseline the margin is the tolerance of 1 case (14 pp in the fiscal group, 25 in the formal one).

targets.rawSql: SELECT LEAST((m->>'fiscal_refusal_accuracy')::float - (m->>'floor_fiscal_refusal_accuracy')::float, (m->>'fiscal_citation_recall')::float - (m->>'floor_fiscal_citation_recall')::float, (m->>'formal_refusal_accuracy')::float - (m->>'floor_formal_refusal_accuracy')::float, (m->>'formal_citation_recall')::float - (m->>'floor_formal_citation_recall')::float) FROM (SELECT metrics AS m, status, exit_code FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'generate_answers' AND status IN ('success','failed') ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1) l

panels.title: False answers
panels.description: An answer shown for a question the law does not answer. The error the 3 barriers exist to stop: ceiling = 0, no tolerance.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE((m->>'fiscal_false_answers')::float, 0) + COALESCE((m->>'formal_false_answers')::float, 0) FROM (SELECT metrics AS m, status, exit_code FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'generate_answers' AND status IN ('success','failed') ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1) l

panels.title: Data checks (latest round)
panels.description: lc214 health checks that did not pass in the latest round.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status NOT IN ('pass','skipped')) AS failures FROM audit.data_quality_checks WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND check_run_id = (SELECT check_run_id FROM audit.data_quality_checks WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' ORDER BY checked_at DESC LIMIT 1)

panels.title: 2 · Data contract (lc01 → lc04): what each step delivered
Latest state of each step
panels.description: skipped (exit 99) = the output was already up to date for this input and code version; not a failure.

targets.rawSql: SELECT s.step AS step, s.status, s.started_at AS started, ROUND(s.duration_s::numeric) AS duration_s, s.rows_in AS rows_in, s.rows_out AS rows_out, (SELECT MAX(started_at) FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs x WHERE x.pipeline = 'lc214' AND x.step = s.step AND x.status = 'success') AS last_success FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (step) * FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' ORDER BY step, started_at DESC) s ORDER BY array_position(ARRAY['extract_source','parse_dispositivos','build_chunks','load_postgres', 'embed_chunks','golden_contract','evaluate_retrieval','generate_answers'], s.step)

panels.title: Health checks (latest round)
panels.description: Law × serving parity, single version, chunks × vectors parity, same law in the vectors, volume and freshness.

targets.rawSql: SELECT check_name AS check, check_type AS type, status, severity AS severity, ROUND(observed_value::numeric, 3) AS observed, LEFT(message, 70) AS message FROM audit.data_quality_checks WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND check_run_id = (SELECT check_run_id FROM audit.data_quality_checks WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' ORDER BY checked_at DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY check_name

panels.title: Volumes: provisions, chunks
panels.description: Parsed provisions (≥ 4,000 by the check) and chunks. An amendment moves these numbers; a drop with no amendment is a broken parser.

targets.rawSql: SELECT started_at AS time, step AS metric, rows_out::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step IN ('parse_dispositivos','build_chunks') AND status = 'success' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Routing and self-citations (golden contract)
panels.description: Do the golden set labels still hold for the current law version? Routing must be 100%; resolved self-citations ≥ 99%.

targets.rawSql: SELECT started_at AS started, status, rows_in AS cases, (metrics->>'routing_accuracy')::float AS routing, (metrics->>'self_ref_rate')::float AS self_citations FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'golden_contract' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND $__timeFilter(started_at) ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: 3 · Retrieval gate (lc05): does the right provision reach the context?
Success@k
panels.description: Every expected provision in the top-k. Gated.

targets.rawSql: SELECT started_at AS time, 'fiscal' AS metric, (metrics->>'fiscal_success_at_k')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'evaluate_retrieval' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'fiscal_success_at_k' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) UNION ALL SELECT started_at AS time, 'fiscal · floor' AS metric, (metrics->>'floor_fiscal_success_at_k')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'evaluate_retrieval' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'floor_fiscal_success_at_k' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) UNION ALL SELECT started_at AS time, 'formal' AS metric, (metrics->>'formal_success_at_k')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'evaluate_retrieval' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'formal_success_at_k' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) UNION ALL SELECT started_at AS time, 'formal · floor' AS metric, (metrics->>'floor_formal_success_at_k')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'evaluate_retrieval' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'floor_formal_success_at_k' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: MRR
panels.description: Position of the first hit (mean of the inverse rank). Gated.

targets.rawSql: SELECT started_at AS time, 'fiscal' AS metric, (metrics->>'fiscal_mrr')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'evaluate_retrieval' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'fiscal_mrr' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) UNION ALL SELECT started_at AS time, 'fiscal · floor' AS metric, (metrics->>'floor_fiscal_mrr')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'evaluate_retrieval' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'floor_fiscal_mrr' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) UNION ALL SELECT started_at AS time, 'formal' AS metric, (metrics->>'formal_mrr')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'evaluate_retrieval' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'formal_mrr' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) UNION ALL SELECT started_at AS time, 'formal · floor' AS metric, (metrics->>'floor_formal_mrr')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'evaluate_retrieval' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'floor_formal_mrr' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Context recall
panels.description: Expected provisions in the context built for the LLM (token budget). Gated.

targets.rawSql: SELECT started_at AS time, 'fiscal' AS metric, (metrics->>'fiscal_context_recall')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'evaluate_retrieval' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'fiscal_context_recall' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) UNION ALL SELECT started_at AS time, 'fiscal · floor' AS metric, (metrics->>'floor_fiscal_context_recall')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'evaluate_retrieval' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'floor_fiscal_context_recall' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) UNION ALL SELECT started_at AS time, 'formal' AS metric, (metrics->>'formal_context_recall')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'evaluate_retrieval' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'formal_context_recall' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) UNION ALL SELECT started_at AS time, 'formal · floor' AS metric, (metrics->>'floor_formal_context_recall')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'evaluate_retrieval' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'floor_formal_context_recall' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Fiscal × formal gap (paired)
panels.description: success@k of the formal phrasing minus the same question in fiscal vocabulary. Measures the vocabulary the retriever does not cover; informational, not gated.

targets.rawSql: SELECT started_at AS time, 'gap' AS metric, (metrics->>'paired_gap')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'evaluate_retrieval' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'paired_gap' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Hit@k and Recall@k (informational)
panels.description: Not gated: they help explain a drop in success@k.

targets.rawSql: SELECT started_at AS time, 'fiscal hit_at_k' AS metric, (metrics->>'fiscal_hit_at_k')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'evaluate_retrieval' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'fiscal_hit_at_k' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) UNION ALL SELECT started_at AS time, 'fiscal recall_at_k' AS metric, (metrics->>'fiscal_recall_at_k')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'evaluate_retrieval' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'fiscal_recall_at_k' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) UNION ALL SELECT started_at AS time, 'formal hit_at_k' AS metric, (metrics->>'formal_hit_at_k')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'evaluate_retrieval' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'formal_hit_at_k' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) UNION ALL SELECT started_at AS time, 'formal recall_at_k' AS metric, (metrics->>'formal_recall_at_k')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'evaluate_retrieval' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'formal_recall_at_k' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 4 · Answer gate (lc06): answers right, refuses when it should, cites what exists?
Refusal accuracy
panels.description: Verdict accuracy: answer when the law has an answer, refuse when it has not. Gated.

targets.rawSql: SELECT started_at AS time, 'fiscal' AS metric, (metrics->>'fiscal_refusal_accuracy')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'generate_answers' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'fiscal_refusal_accuracy' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) UNION ALL SELECT started_at AS time, 'fiscal · floor' AS metric, (metrics->>'floor_fiscal_refusal_accuracy')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'generate_answers' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'floor_fiscal_refusal_accuracy' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) UNION ALL SELECT started_at AS time, 'formal' AS metric, (metrics->>'formal_refusal_accuracy')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'generate_answers' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'formal_refusal_accuracy' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) UNION ALL SELECT started_at AS time, 'formal · floor' AS metric, (metrics->>'floor_formal_refusal_accuracy')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'generate_answers' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'floor_formal_refusal_accuracy' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Citation recall
panels.description: Of the expected answers, how many cite the expected provision. Gated.

targets.rawSql: SELECT started_at AS time, 'fiscal' AS metric, (metrics->>'fiscal_citation_recall')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'generate_answers' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'fiscal_citation_recall' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) UNION ALL SELECT started_at AS time, 'fiscal · floor' AS metric, (metrics->>'floor_fiscal_citation_recall')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'generate_answers' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'floor_fiscal_citation_recall' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) UNION ALL SELECT started_at AS time, 'formal' AS metric, (metrics->>'formal_citation_recall')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'generate_answers' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'formal_citation_recall' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) UNION ALL SELECT started_at AS time, 'formal · floor' AS metric, (metrics->>'floor_formal_citation_recall')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'generate_answers' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'floor_formal_citation_recall' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Citation validity
panels.description: Citations that exist in the law AND were in the context shown. Below 100% = the model cited what it did not see.

targets.rawSql: SELECT started_at AS time, 'fiscal' AS metric, (metrics->>'fiscal_citation_validity')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'generate_answers' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'fiscal_citation_validity' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) UNION ALL SELECT started_at AS time, 'formal' AS metric, (metrics->>'formal_citation_validity')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'generate_answers' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'formal_citation_validity' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: False answers and false refusals
panels.description: false_answers: ceiling 0 (strict gate). false_refusals: the cost of being conservative, where quality is being lost today.

targets.rawSql: SELECT started_at AS time, 'fiscal false_answers' AS metric, (metrics->>'fiscal_false_answers')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'generate_answers' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'fiscal_false_answers' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) UNION ALL SELECT started_at AS time, 'fiscal false_refusals' AS metric, (metrics->>'fiscal_false_refusals')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'generate_answers' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'fiscal_false_refusals' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) UNION ALL SELECT started_at AS time, 'formal false_answers' AS metric, (metrics->>'formal_false_answers')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'generate_answers' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'formal_false_answers' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) UNION ALL SELECT started_at AS time, 'formal false_refusals' AS metric, (metrics->>'formal_false_refusals')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'generate_answers' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'formal_false_refusals' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Share of replies the model says it can answer
panels.description: How often the model claims it can answer, before the barriers. Stuck near 0 = the model refuses everything.

targets.rawSql: SELECT started_at AS time, 'fiscal model_says_answerable' AS metric, (metrics->>'fiscal_model_says_answerable')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'generate_answers' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'fiscal_model_says_answerable' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) UNION ALL SELECT started_at AS time, 'formal model_says_answerable' AS metric, (metrics->>'formal_model_says_answerable')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'generate_answers' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'formal_model_says_answerable' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Drift since the baseline
panels.description: A record, not a gate. Stable verdict + reworded text = non-reproducible wording; a verdict flip = behaviour changed.

targets.rawSql: SELECT started_at AS time, 'verdict flips' AS metric, (metrics->>'verdict_flips')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'generate_answers' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'verdict_flips' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) UNION ALL SELECT started_at AS time, 'texts reworded' AS metric, (metrics->>'text_changed')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'generate_answers' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'text_changed' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) UNION ALL SELECT started_at AS time, 'expected citation changed' AS metric, (metrics->>'cited_expected_changed')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'generate_answers' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'cited_expected_changed' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Latency per phrasing (s)
panels.description: CPU, qwen2.5:3b, num_ctx 6144. DAG budget: 90 min for 11 phrasings.

targets.rawSql: SELECT started_at AS time, 'fiscal p50' AS metric, (metrics->>'fiscal_latency_p50_s')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'generate_answers' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'fiscal_latency_p50_s' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) UNION ALL SELECT started_at AS time, 'formal p50' AS metric, (metrics->>'formal_latency_p50_s')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'generate_answers' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'formal_latency_p50_s' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) UNION ALL SELECT started_at AS time, 'fiscal max' AS metric, (metrics->>'fiscal_latency_max_s')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'generate_answers' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'fiscal_latency_max_s' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) UNION ALL SELECT started_at AS time, 'formal max' AS metric, (metrics->>'formal_latency_max_s')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'generate_answers' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'formal_latency_max_s' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Tokens per word (budget calibration)
panels.description: The retriever estimates 1.7 tokens/word; lc06 measures it with prompt_eval_count. An estimate below the measured value = context overflowing num_ctx.

targets.rawSql: SELECT started_at AS time, 'measured' AS metric, (metrics->>'tokens_per_word')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'generate_answers' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'tokens_per_word' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Answer gate runs
panels.description: Includes skipped runs (--once: same fingerprint, nothing to generate). exit_code 143 = killed from outside (interrupted), 1 = the gate or the step failed.

targets.rawSql: SELECT started_at AS started, status, ROUND(duration_s::numeric) AS duration_s, metrics->>'variant' AS variant, metrics->>'decision' AS rule, (metrics->>'fiscal_refusal_accuracy')::float AS fiscal_refusal_acc, (metrics->>'formal_citation_recall')::float AS formal_cit_recall, (metrics->>'verdict_flips')::int AS flips, exit_code, LEFT(error_message, 60) AS error FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'generate_answers' AND status <> 'running' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 20
